title: Core Mechanics & Animal Classifications
lede: The systemic rules governing animal biology, classification archetypes, passive advantages, and turn-by-turn resolution loops.

categories.name: Herbivore
categories.passive: Efficient Grazer: Receives 25% extra nourishment when consuming vegetation. Superior fleeing speed.
categories.description: High agility prey specialists relying on evasion, wide sensory detection, and rapid grazing to outlast predators.

categories.name: Carnivore
categories.passive: Ambush Predator: Deals 50% bonus damage when attacking an unsuspecting target from dense vegetation or stealth tiles.
categories.description: Powerful apex predators requiring high caloric intake from successful hunts, balanced by severe starvation penalties.

categories.name: Omnivore
categories.passive: Iron Stomach: 50% resistance against toxic and spoiled food sources, enabling opportunistic survival in barren zones.
categories.description: Adaptable generalists capable of shifting nutritional strategies based on seasonal food availability and disaster conditions.

traits.name: Strength (STR)
traits.role: Determines raw melee combat damage and intimidation checks against rivals.

traits.name: Agility (AGI)
traits.role: Governs movement energy discounts, evasion odds (5% per point), and initiative order.

traits.name: Endurance (END)
traits.role: Expands maximum Health (+10 per point) and maximum Energy pool (+5 per point).

traits.name: Intelligence (INT)
traits.role: Increases success rates on complex environmental events and puzzle objects.

statusVariables.name: Health (HP)
statusVariables.decay: Takes damage when starving, dehydrated, poisoned, or attacked.

statusVariables.name: Hunger
statusVariables.decay: Depletes at 5 points per turn. Triggers starvation damage at 0.

statusVariables.name: Thirst
statusVariables.decay: Depletes at 8 points per turn. Triggers severe dehydration damage at 0.

statusVariables.name: Energy
statusVariables.decay: Expended by movement and combat. Regenerates passively or via Resting.

statusVariables.name: Instinct
statusVariables.decay: Flips to Alert when hostile entities or hazards enter Moore neighborhood.

turnCycle.detail: The environment compiles the animal's local 3x3 perception matrix and internal status vector into a 41-element normalized array.
The MLP performs forward propagation across its dual ReLU hidden layers, computing activation scores across 8 output action nodes.
The simulation executes the winning action (movement, foraging, drinking, fighting, resting), updating grid coordinates and tile contents.
Metabolic counters drop: hunger (-5), thirst (-8). Energy drains according to terrain cost; passive regeneration is applied if resting.
Active environmental hazards (fire, poison, weather) tick damage. Animals reaching 0 Health expire and become food resources.
